mcqs.question: During the August 2026 India–Uzbekistan engagement, what environmental assistance was announced for the Aral Sea region?
options: A $1 million grant under Yashil Makon and Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam
Joint exploration and processing of critical minerals
Restoration of the Buddhist sites Fayaz Tepa and Kara Tepa
mcqs.explanation: India announced a $1 million grant for the Aral Sea region under the Yashil Makon and Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam initiatives. The other options concern uranium, critical minerals and heritage cooperation, respectively, rather than the environmental assistance for the Aral Sea region.
